question: If Tappei-san, too, had the blessing that Otto holds, how would you use it?
answer: Exactly as is written in the story, Otto’s blessing is an uncommonly frightening thing, so I’d be fairly wary.  Being able to talk with animals isn’t always a good thing.  So, I’d probably try to not use it much.  I’d try to come to an accommodation with the horses at the racetrack.
